replaces_binding.reason: Initial claim fence elapsed before the packet completed; no claim, GPU invocation, or scientific submission occurred.

immutable_scientific_contract.operands: Unchanged official per-token activation and per-tensor weight E4M3FN quantizers with identical in-process tensors and scales for stock and candidate.
immutable_scientific_contract.oracle: Synchronized stock first call, synchronized candidate first call, finite full BF16 output, then full-output bitwise equality before timing.

staged_execution.first: Submit only sliding_qkv stock and candidate synchronized first calls.
continue_only_if: all physical grid extents are nonzero
210944-byte shared storage is within the live opt-in limit
candidate output is bitwise equal to stock
staged_execution.then: Continue the unchanged runner through the other five families without replaying sliding_qkv.

mutable_integration.allowed: Ordinary staging, source-tree reuse, build, import, UID, path, API, retrieval, and incomplete-family repairs that preserve every immutable scientific field.
mutable_integration.retention: Keep the claim and heartbeat through recoverable incomplete outcomes while the closest measured restart plus terminal/release margin fits.

release_predicates.decision_bearing: Release available after a complete exactness-stop or six-row terminal whose identities, provenance, numerical oracle, hashes, timing fields, and ledgers satisfy this binding.
release_predicates.geometric_falsification: With positive sm_count and a legal nonzero grid, cudaErrorInvalidConfiguration rejects this correction as insufficient; persist the launch ledger and release maintenance without replay.
release_predicates.incomplete: Build, import, staging, retrieval, or missing minimum stock/candidate output remains under same-claim repair until measured fit or the owner deadline requires maintenance release.
release_predicates.unsafe: Release maintenance immediately for an unsafe or unreachable guest.

stop_rule.stage_1: Stop before later families on illegal launch metadata, CUDA launch failure, nonfinite output, or non-bitwise output.
stop_rule.stage_2: After six bitwise-equal rows, stop without endpoint if any family regresses over 5%, weighted quant-plus-GEMM saving is nonpositive, or projected saving is below 0.001 s/request.
forbidden: replay M16 or the failed zero-grid source
change scientific operands, scales, kernel geometry, oracle, warmups, or repetitions
load the model or run an endpoint
